legacyTitle: Ihavandhoo Island | Haa Alifu Atoll, Maldives - Northern Island Experience

faqs.question: How do I get to Ihavandhoo Island?
faqs.answer: Fly to Hanimaadhoo (1hr) then take a 40-minute speedboat. Weekly ferries from Male take 16-18 hours.

faqs.question: When is the best time to visit?
faqs.answer: December-April offers dry, sunny weather with calm seas. Water remains warm year-round.

faqs.question: What makes Ihavandhoo special?
faqs.answer: Its authentic northern culture, fishing heritage, and pristine environment away from mass tourism.

faqs.question: Are there dress requirements?
faqs.answer: Modest dress in public (shoulders/knees covered). Swimwear only at designated bikini beach.

faqs.question: What marine life will I see?
faqs.answer: Reef sharks, turtles, rays, and abundant tropical fish on the healthy house reef.
